question.text: Fund ABC has set-up cost of Rs. 1.25 crore amortized over 5 years. What is the annual amortized set-up cost?

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Rs. 1.25 crore ÷ 5 years = Rs. 25 lakh per year. **The Trap:** Rs. 12.5 lakh is over 10 years; Rs. 50 lakh is over 2.5 years; Rs. 1.25 crore is full upfront. **Cross-Exam Context:** Classic straight-line amortisation used across the industry. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** In the distributor's illustration, show the amortised charge separately so investors can see its net-NAV impact.
